root_idea.summary: The root denotes extension, flatness, and breadth: something spread out or broad in form.
root_idea.development: From the idea of an extended surface developed the senses of ground or facial surface, a sheet used for writing, a broad bowl, and related written collections. The Quranic plural صُحُف refers either to written pages or to revealed scriptures presented in written form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the singular citation form صَحْفَة, whose plural is صِحَاف.
Displayed under the singular citation form صَحِيفَة, whose plurals include صُحُف.

senses.definition: A broad, shallow bowl or serving dish.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural صِحَاف, referring to broad vessels used for serving.

senses.definition: A written sheet, page, or leaf.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the plural صُحُف for physically written pages or sheets; the context may emphasize their material form.

senses.definition: A revealed scripture or collection of sacred writings.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for scriptures associated with prophets, including the revealed writings of Abraham and Moses. The expression can refer to revelation as a written collection rather than merely to individual physical leaves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An error made in reading or transmitting a written text because of ambiguity in its letters; also alteration of wording, vocalization, or diacritical points so that the intended meaning changes or becomes doubtful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A postclassical technical usage associated with mistakes in a صحيفة or in the reading and transmission of written language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have written sheets collected in it or placed in it between two boards.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive construction describing the formation of a board-bound collection of written sheets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered in wording so as to convey a meaning different from what was intended, or to become doubtful to the reader.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a word or expression that has undergone textual corruption or has become ambiguous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who makes mistakes in reading or writing a written text.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning concerns faulty engagement with a صحيفة, especially through misreading its letters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A learner who acquires knowledge from written sources rather than directly from teachers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This designation places such a learner below those instructed by established scholars or teachers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small places or depressions where water collects and remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Classical plural usage; the corresponding singular is صَحْف or a related form, and the plural is also given as صُحُف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The surface of the ground or earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension based on resemblance to a flat writing surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written work or document; by extension, a book, volume, epistle, booklet, or register.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use of the singular, extending from the written sheet to the written work or record itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A record of a person's deeds kept in heaven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or theological use referring to an individual's heavenly record.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plank, board, or leaf forming part of a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to a flat structural piece.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The outer skin or surface of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical use, especially the part of the face that fronts the observer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A layer or sheet of fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for a flat layer or stratum of fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of books or written volumes; also a maker or binder of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational designation derived from صُحُف or written books.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A codex consisting of written sheets collected and placed between two boards.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is commonly applied to a bound copy of the Qur'an, while retaining the broader sense of a bound collection of written sheets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A section or booklet forming part of a larger book.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A secondary Classical use, distinct from the primary sense of a complete collection of sheets between boards.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Technical meanings of textual misreading and alteration are represented.
Passive construction for collecting sheets is represented.
The broad bowl meaning is represented by the Quranic form.
Both the faulty reader and written-source learner meanings are represented.
The water-collecting depression meaning is represented separately.
Written sheets, revealed scriptures, broader written works, and heavenly deed records are all represented.
Door plank or leaf meaning is represented.
Bookseller and bookbinder occupational meanings are represented.
Both the bound codex and secondary book-section meanings are represented.

cautions: The Quranic forms صِحَاف and صُحُف are distinct plural lexemes: the former belongs to صَحْفَة, a broad bowl, while the latter belongs to صَحِيفَة, a written sheet or scripture. صُحُف also has a separate Classical water-collecting-place usage, kept apart from the Quranic meanings.
